verdict.rationale: Zapier exposes developer APIs (Workflow API, stored-actions endpoints), so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question to ask. However, the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger file at any candidate path (all 404), and no first-party doc mentions one. The llms.txt and llms-full.txt files are prose documentation indexes rather than a machine-readable API spec, and the typed SDK is not a spec download.
